items.text: Round 3 decisions incorporated into conclusion: (d1→A) approvals are commit-scoped with no channel dimension — Finding 13 updated from 'open decision' to resolved, with implications spelled out; (d2→A) only publishing deployments create release records — new Finding 15 added, Actions 1 and 7 updated; (d3→A) superseded status set by application-level orchestrator logic in the same transaction as the publish update — new Finding 16 added, Actions 1 and 7 updated.

Summary section expanded to reflect all three round 3 decisions. Methodology updated to note round 3 synthesis. Limitations section cleaned: removed two 'depends on open decision' entries, replaced with concrete limitation descriptions matching the resolved decisions (commit-scoped approval trade-off, superseded crash-recovery concern).

Readiness assessment: problem_clarity=3 (all 10 decisions across 3 rounds are resolved, no open questions remain), scope_defined=2 (acceptance_allow is set but no acceptance_deny; the 7 actions clearly bound the implementation scope), approach_solid=3 (detailed SQL schema, Go types, pipeline extension points, and all design decisions settled), testable=2 (4 concrete verification paths identified but not a formal test plan with expected assertions and coverage targets), risk_awareness=3 (6 limitations documented with mitigations or notes for implementation).

Remaining gap: testable is at 2 rather than 3 because the verification paths (Finding 14) describe test strategies but don't specify exact test cases, expected assertions, or coverage targets. This is acceptable for a research conclusion — the execute items that implement the schema should define their own detailed test plans.

plan_updates: Finalization pass: incorporated all round 3 answered decisions into conclusion.md. Added Findings 15 (dry-run exclusion) and 16 (superseded status logic). Updated Findings 13, Summary, Methodology, Limitations, and Actions 1/5/7 to reflect resolved decisions. No open decisions remain.
